title: agent-start.sh: add Rust, jedi repo, and ZUBAN_TYPESHED setup steps
description: Improve scripts/agent-start.sh to match jedi's script quality: verify/install Rust toolchain, ensure the jedi repo is checked out alongside, set ZUBAN_TYPESHED in .agent-env, and verify the debug binary exists (or run cargo build).
design:
## Steps to add (modelled on jedi's agent-start.sh)

### Rust toolchain check
After bd/jq checks, verify cargo is available:
  if ! command -v cargo &>/dev/null; then
    source ~/.cargo/env 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  if ! command -v cargo &>/dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: cargo not found. Install Rust from https://rustup.rs" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

### Ensure zuban is built
  if [ ! -f "target/debug/zuban" ]; then
    echo "Building zuban (first run, may take a few minutes)..."
    cargo build
  fi

### Ensure jedi repo is checked out alongside
  JEDI_DIR="$(cd .. && pwd)/jedi"
  if [ ! -d "$JEDI_DIR" ]; then
    echo "Cloning jedi alongside zuban..."
    git clone https://github.com/emclain/jedi "$JEDI_DIR" --branch refactoring-test-coverage
  fi
  if [ ! -d "$JEDI_DIR/.venv" ]; then
    echo "Setting up jedi Python venv..."
    python3 -m venv "$JEDI_DIR/.venv"
    "$JEDI_DIR/.venv/bin/pip" install -q -e "$JEDI_DIR/[testing]"
  fi

### Add ZUBAN_TYPESHED and JEDI_DIR to .agent-env
  cat >> "$worktree/.agent-env" <<ENVEOF
export ZUBAN_TYPESHED=$REPO_ROOT/third_party/typeshed
export JEDI_DIR=$JEDI_DIR
ENVEOF

### Update the final instructions to include test run
  echo "  bash scripts/run_jedi_rename_tests.sh   # run rename tests"

title: Rename: module/file rename not implemented
description: Renaming a module does not produce a file rename operation (rename from/to), only updates the import reference. Jedi produces a file rename plus source edits.

title: Rename: var-not-found, keyword-param2, nonlocal-rename return null unexpectedly
description: Three cases return null/error from zuban where a rename result is expected: var-not-found (renaming an undefined variable), keyword-param2, and nonlocal-rename. Needs investigation to determine if these are adapter issues or zuban gaps.

title: Rename: string annotations not updated (forward references)
description: String annotations used as forward references (e.g. def f(x: 'Foo') -> 'Foo') are not updated when the referenced name is renamed. Jedi recently added this support.

title: Rename: keyword argument call sites not updated
description: When renaming a parameter, zuban renames the def site and body but not keyword argument uses at call sites (e.g. f(param=3) → f(lala=3)). Jedi handles this correctly.

title: Rename: cross-file edits not returned for definition file
description: When renaming a symbol defined in another file, zuban only returns edits for the importing file, not the file where the symbol is defined. The definition site is left unchanged.

title: Zuban test harness: launch server and feed jedi fixture cases via adapter
description: Write the harness that builds and launches zuban as a stdio LSP server, integrates with the adapter (zuban-elm), and wires everything into pytest.
design:
## Responsibilities

The adapter (zuban-elm) handles fixture parsing and LSP message translation.
This harness owns everything around the server process:

- Build zuban (cargo build) or locate an existing binary
- Launch zuban as a subprocess with stdio transport
- Pass the server command into the adapter's --lsp-cmd option
- Manage server lifecycle: startup, per-session initialization, shutdown
- Handle server crashes or unexpected exits gracefully (mark affected cases as errors)

## pytest Integration

- conftest.py fixture that builds/locates the zuban binary (session-scoped)
- A session-scoped LspServer fixture that starts zuban once per test file
- --zuban-bin option to skip the build step and point at an existing binary
- --lsp-cmd falls back to the located binary if not explicitly given

## Build Step

  cargo build --bin zuban 2>&1

Cache the binary path in a session-scoped fixture. If the build fails, skip
the entire test session with a clear message rather than failing each test.

## Startup Handshake

After launching the process, complete the LSP initialize/initialized handshake
before running any cases. Fail fast with a useful message if the server does
not respond within a timeout (e.g. 10s).

## Fixture File Scoping

One zuban process per fixture file (matches adapter spec). The harness
should support pytest's parametrize grouping so the server is not restarted
between cases in the same file.

## Out of Scope

- Testing non-rename LSP features
- Multi-workspace or multi-root setups
- Notebook support

title: LSP rename adapter: run jedi fixture-format tests against any LSP server
description: Build a thin pytest adapter that parses jedi's #? fixture format and drives rename operations against a stdio LSP server, enabling cross-server comparison of rename behavior.
design:
## Scope

- Rename only. Other refactoring types (inline, extract, etc.) are out of scope.
- Single-file cases only. Multi-file rename (e.g. the _path kwarg in jedi fixtures) is out of scope.
- No jedi dependency at runtime.

## Inputs

1. A fixture file in jedi's refactor format (e.g. test/refactor/rename.py)
2. A command to launch the LSP server (e.g. \`zuban --stdio\`, \`jedi-language-server\`)

## Case Parsing

Reuse _collect_file_tests from test/refactor.py as-is. Each RefactoringCase gives:
- case._code — the source text (including the #? marker line)
- case._line_nr — 1-indexed line number of the rename target (line after #?)
- case._index — 0-indexed column of the rename target
- case._kwargs['new_name'] — the new name
- case.type — 'diff', 'text', or 'error'
- case.get_desired_result() — the expected output string

## LSP Client

A minimal asyncio stdio client. Messages needed:
- initialize (handshake; request UTF-8 position encoding)
- initialized notification
- textDocument/didOpen
- textDocument/rename
- shutdown + exit

One server process per test file (not per case) to avoid startup overhead.

## Position Mapping

- lsp_line = case._line_nr - 1  (LSP is 0-indexed)
- lsp_character = case._index   (0-indexed in both)
- Negotiate UTF-8 encoding in initialize to avoid UTF-16 offset issues

## Result Comparison

diff cases: apply WorkspaceEdit edits to case._code, produce unified diff with
difflib.unified_diff. Header uses fixture basename (e.g. "--- rename.py").

text cases: apply edits and return full resulting source text.

error cases: pass if server returns LSP error response or null result.
Do not check error message text (messages differ across servers).

## Applying Text Edits

Apply edits end-to-start (by position) to avoid offset drift.

## Interface

  pytest test/test_lsp_rename.py --lsp-cmd="zuban --stdio"

--lsp-cmd is a required option. Cases parametrized with ids like rename-simple.

## Out of Scope

- Error message text comparison
- prepareRename testing
- File renames
- Multi-file cases
- Non-rename refactorings
